provenance: Authored by hand for teaching. No value here is a real measurement, no molecule was assayed, and nothing is a screening proposal. The numbers are plausible in shape so the arithmetic is legible, and they are not data.
stores: Measurements and declared rules. No molecule carries a class label, because a class is produced by a choice and this lab is about the choices.

endpoint.quantity: negative log of a hypothetical binding constant, in the shape of a pChEMBL value
endpoint.what_the_uncertainty_means: A repeat measurement of the same compound is expected to move by about this much. A compound within this distance of a cutoff has not been placed on either side of it by the measurement.

primary_threshold.statement: Compounds at or above this value are called positives. The value is a choice. Nothing in the measurement selects it.

decoys.what_they_are: Molecules assumed not to bind because they were property-matched to the positives and never tested. They carry no measurement of any kind.
decoys.assumption: Selected under the assumption that a property-matched untested molecule is inactive. That assumption is not evidence, and every decoy below would become a measured compound the moment anyone ran the assay.

generalization_units.scaffold: Compounds sharing a Bemis-Murcko scaffold count once, because a split that separates molecules but not scaffolds puts near-copies on both sides.
generalization_units.acyclic_note: An acyclic molecule has no Bemis-Murcko scaffold. The unit is not merely coarser for such a compound, it is undefined, and the lab reports how many are in that state rather than quietly assigning them one.
